metadata.description: SimSites: simulate features of your app first, then build and verify them with Claude Code.

plugins.name: simsites
plugins.description: Design a UI feature as short simulations (sims) of your app's real screens before building it: Claude draws them, you watch and approve them on one page (or refine them in the conversation), then Claude builds from the approved frames and verifies by replaying them in a real browser.
